verdict.rationale: Aircall documents Messages endpoints for sending SMS programmatically and messaging webhooks for tracking SMS activity. Together these cover outbound sending and an event stream that likely includes inbound messages. The evidence is only tutorial titles, though, and never states that the webhooks report per-message delivery status (sent/delivered/failed). Missing for 10: explicit delivery-status callback events, explicit documentation of receiving inbound SMS via the API or webhooks, in-depth endpoint reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
